insight: 1Password CLI commands work even when `op whoami` reports "not signed in" — don't ask Josh to run `op signin` first. Just call the op command directly (e.g. `op item get <id> --reveal`). The cached session and op-batch-load layer are independent of `op whoami` state. The right move is to TRY op first; fall back to asking only if a real op command fails with an auth error.

insight: op item get / op item list work via the 1Password 8 desktop app GUI biometric prompt, independent of TTY. op whoami can report 'account is not signed in' while real op commands still succeed. Do not gate scripts on op whoami, and do not assume 'no TTY = no Touch ID' — the desktop integration surfaces the prompt from any context as long as the 1P app is running on the logged-in desktop. The /1pass-warm Phase 0 bail-on-no-TTY assumption is wrong.
evidence: reproduced 2026-05-16 in Claude Code harness; op whoami → not signed in, op item list + 16 op item get calls succeeded with biometric via GUI

insight: 1Password.app Settings → Developer → Biometric Unlock for 1Password CLI is enabled on every machine (set up via /machine-setup Phase 2 and persists across reboots/updates). When op times out, the cause is something else (locked vault, stale agent socket after a 1P update, swallowed prompt) — NOT the biometric setup. Do not suggest enabling it.

insight: 1Password API_CREDENTIAL items use field name 'credential' (not token/api_token/secret). Wrong field returns empty silently. Use op item get <id> --fields credential.
